prayerExcerpt.en-US: "The Eucharist is my highway to Heaven!"
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "A Eucaristia é a minha autoestrada para o Céu!"

meta.face: A Milanese boy of fifteen with a light olive complexion and a SOFT, BROAD OVAL face with FULL, rounded cheeks — a smooth forehead half-covered by a THICK, TOUSLED MOP of dark-brown CURLS, straight, dark brows, warm brown eyes a little narrowed by a smile, a straight nose with a softly rounded tip, a WIDE mouth in an easy, closed-lipped, slightly crooked smile, and a firm, rounded chin; the gaze frank and friendly, toward us. Not the square-jawed pier_giorgio_frassati with his hair brushed up, nor the fine, slender aloysius_gonzaga.
meta.basis: His photographs (the portrait in the red polo shirt on English Wikipedia; the Dicastery's portrait): a soft, broad oval face with full cheeks under a mop of dark curls, straight dark brows, brown eyes and a wide, easy smile. The Dicastery records his daily Mass, his website of Eucharistic miracles, his love of Assisi and his burial there.
meta.excerpt: His saying «L'Eucaristia è la mia autostrada per il Cielo!», quoted twice on the Dicastery's page (in the Latin decree, «Eucharistia est mea via autocinetica ad caelum!»); a single short quotation, our rendering (he died in 2006)
